title: bidens rubifolia var. coreopsidis
intro: Bidens rubifolia var. coreopsidis, commonly known as Coreopsis Bidens, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to the southern United States. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects that can aid in wound healing and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce fever and alleviate pain, while its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Bidens rubifolia var. coreopsidis include its potential to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation, making it a valuable plant in the development of new herbal remedies.
